title: Admin-Path Syllabus Node Requires Admin Approve
description: The agent module shall keep the syllabus node in awaiting_review on the admin-authoring path until the admin explicitly approves it.
rationale: Admin-authored drafts have no prior intake approval; the syllabus is generated fresh and must pass the same HITL gate as any other node to satisfy the provenance requirement before the draft can be published to an assignment.
